description: This PHP source file implements a database-backed session container class 'HTTP_Session_Container_MDB' which manages session data storage and retrieval using a MDB database connection. It includes methods for connection, reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collection of session data, along with configuration options.

classes.name: HTTP_Session_Container_MDB
classes.description: Database session container class that uses MDB for persistent storage of session data.

methods.name: HTTP_Session_Container_MDB
methods.description: Constructor that initializes options and sets defaults.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the MDB database using the provided DSN.

methods.name: _setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration options for DSN, table name, and autooptimize.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the session storage by connecting to the database.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database for the specified session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to the database, updating or inserting as needed.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes session data for the specified session ID.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Replicates session data into another table if specified.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection of expired sessions, with optional table optimization.
